answer: Harbor peer-audit bond: a newcomer locks a 70-credit bond and registers one jetty berth on the harbor log. Each epoch a random peer re-measures the berth with a hollow sounding tube. A missing or faked sounding burns the bond; an auditor passing a hollow reading loses its own bond too. First identity costs 40, the kth 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, for at most 40,000 rewards. An honest agent pays 40 once.
